comment: What a release build advertises. scripts/acceptance.py verifies every entry against the INSTALLED binaries; CMake refuses to configure a release (R3DSS_RELEASE=ON) when a requirement is missing. Add a capability here only together with its acceptance check.

capabilities.description: CinemaDNG sensor mosaic in, smaller CinemaDNG sensor mosaic out, resampled in the Bayer domain (no debayer), with frame rate, duration, audio and timecode preserved
Recognise REDCODE RAW, Nikon R3D NE and NEV clips by content and list their container chunks (no decoding)
Open REDCODE RAW / R3D NE clips through the RED R3D SDK for identification and verification. This is NOT RAW-to-RAW: the SDK only returns developed RGB (docs/FEASIBILITY.md).
